mintAuthority.summary: AID uses role-gated issuer minting. On Ethereum, two contract MINTER_ROLE holders are confirmed active (4099 and 3162 bytes). DEFAULT_ADMIN is held by both a 3/5 Safe and an EOA (confirmed no bytecode). On Arbitrum, Base, and BSC, the same DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe and EOA are confirmed; MINTER_ROLE has no active grants on those chains (different impl, bridge-minted).

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294761: hasRole confirmed for all four controls (MINTER_ROLE×2 contract holders, DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe 3/5, DEFAULT_ADMIN EOA). Both MINTER_ROLE holders are contracts (4099 and 3162 bytes); 0x410C19….owner()=EOA 0x3885be…; 0xE2E142….owner()=contract 0xee0cd7c…. EOA 0x3885be… confirmed no bytecode. DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe 3/5 confirmed (threshold 3, 5 owners, no modules, no guard). Same DEFAULT_ADMIN Safe and EOA confirmed on Arbitrum, Base, and BSC via hasRole. Arb/Base/BSC MINTER_ROLE has no active holders (different impl 0xfd8cf705… from Ethereum); minting on those chains routes via bridge contract authorized by DEFAULT_ADMIN. GAIB names McMillan Woods (Hong Kong) CPA for periodic reports, but GAIB's transparency documentation scopes that work to verifying the GPU/AI-financing deployment (e.g. the June 2026 Spiceflow assurance report), not an AID reserve-versus-circulating-supply reconciliation, and AID's dollar backing is shown only via self-displayed on-chain addresses, so no credible independent recurring reconciliation of AID reserves was found and reconciliation is unknown. Singapore's stablecoin regime covers only SGD/G10-pegged issuers and no MAS licence or other prudential authorisation for GAIB/AID was located, so supervision is none. 2026-07-20 follow-up: the token is a UUPS proxy (EIP-1967 implementation 0x2db74834f556e1f19ed397e5f935a983e4c2f38b, proxiableUUID() returns the EIP-1967 slot, UPGRADE_INTERFACE_VERSION = '5.0.0', upgradeToAndCall present); upgrade authorization is role-gated in the implementation, so the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders (Safe 0x32793F6B... 3/5 and EOA 0x3885be...) can change mint-critical logic. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer-controlled EOA administration and upgrade authority make minting economically unbounded; no whole-supply independent reconciliation or named prudential supervisor is evidenced. Wave 2 external review 2026-08-15: GAIB's Q1 update repeats a McMillan Woods monthly-attestation claim, but no AID reserve-versus-all-chain-supply report is retrievable from GAIB, its dashboard, or the accountant, so reconciliation remains unknown and supervision remains none.
